details: @servicetitan/anvil-react@0.11.7 is a trojanized React UI library. The preinstall hook (package/setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and extracts it, then executes a 727KB obfuscated payload (package/math_init.js) through Bun. The payload uses child_process, eval, and Function constructors. The dist/ directory contains a legitimate-looking React component library (Alert, Button, Calendar, etc.) to disguise the malicious behaviour. No repository URL is declared. The package depends on @servicetitan/anvil-icon and @servicetitan/anvil-token, which are also known-malware packages.
